faq.title: Straight answers
faq.q1: What if a supplier takes longer than 14 days?
faq.a1: RADR keeps the case open until it resolves or is closed.
faq.q2: Do we have to replace our accounting or procurement stack?
faq.a2: No. RADR is designed to work across the systems already in use.
faq.a3: Not unless explicitly permitted by policy. Material external actions can remain approval-gated.
faq.q4: How does RADR define Verified Value?
faq.a4: Only when downstream evidence supports the economic outcome — for example a credit applied and matched to the original invoice.
